page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-4-lssd belongs to the general-purpose compute family, offering a balanced resource profile for enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. The hardware allocation delivers 4 dedicated vCPUs spread across 2 physical execution cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity totals 15.0 GB, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU, supported by a 504 MB L3 cache. The CPU features extensive hardware extensions, including AVX-512 vector acceleration and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for integer and bfloat16 operations. Hardware acceleration remains restricted to CPU-level instruction sets, as no discrete GPUs are present.

Storage architecture is anchored by a bundled 402 GB local NVMe solid-state drive, removing network storage latency for local data access. In empirical benchmarks, the instance demonstrates standout single-threaded performance, ranking in the top decile for Geekbench single-core execution (2304.0), single-threaded gzip compression (37.03 GB/sec), and bzip3 decompression. However, parallel throughput profiles highlight the ceiling of a 4-thread execution model: multi-core stress-ng tests and multi-threaded decompression reflect lower-tier performance relative to broader cloud baselines. Memory subsystems yield typical read throughput of 42.84 GB/sec on large blocks, but large-block write speeds trail at 23.42 GB/sec. Large model inference reflects similar bottlenecks, with 7B parameter text generation limited to 4.89 tokens per second.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the c4-standard-4-lssd offers high utility when single-thread execution latency and direct NVMe storage bandwidth dominate system requirements. The integration of high-performing individual CPU cores alongside low-latency local NVMe storage establishes strong technical fit for intermediate relational databases, Redis key-value operations, static and dynamic web application hosting, CI/CD build environments, and ETL data staging pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-4-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz across 2 physical cores. The instance is configured with 15.0 GB of memory (3.75 GB per core) and integrates a 402 GB local NVMe solid-state drive for low-latency storage. CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AMX matrix acceleration. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate exceptional single-core processing capabilities, placing top-tier results in single-threaded gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench single-core testing. Conversely, multi-core throughput and large-block memory write bandwidth fall into lower percentiles due to the 4-thread hardware boundary. With no bundled GPU, the machine is not suited for demanding AI model inference. The configuration provides balanced resource efficiency for workloads requiring fast per-core execution and fast local disk access, such as caching tiers, relational databases, CI/CD runners, and web application serving.
